text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm preparing a proactive capacity commitment request for Q3 to cover our Dedicated warm pool in us-west-2. We want a steady baseline of 40 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs (+ burst for traffic spikes). Need input on quota/ENI/subnet risks and a clean justification for cloud support.

aj: Looks reasonable. For quota we should request both Compute (A100 family) and ENI/IP limits per AZ. Also ask for a placement group exception if needed for low-latency vs spread.

sasha: Agree. Two immediate risk items: 1) subnet IP exhaustion in the warm subnets when we spin up many nodes, 2) ENI/sec limits for our VM types when autoscaling. We hit that last quarter with a canary.

maria: Good call. Drafting the quota text now. Proposal includes: 40 guaranteed GPUs (reserved pool), 20 burst GPUs for 1-hour windows, ENI increase to 300 per account in us-west-2, and subnet IPs increased by 1024 for the warm pool subnets. Also requesting faster quota processing (72h SLA) due to release date.

leo: For cost justification, call out predicted token-throughput and QPS contours. Ops numbers: with our traffic model baseline utilization 65% on reserved, expected 5-10% overflow to spot. Include expected monthly spend delta vs current.

maria: Pasting the quota justification block I'm planning to send to support — feel free to copy-edit:

```
Request: Increase quota and capacity for Dedicated warm GPU pool in us-west-2
Reason: We are launching a customer-facing feature with a deterministic latency SLO. To meet 99th percentile latency and avoid cold-start penalties we require a reserved warm pool with guaranteed GPU capacity.
Requested increases:
- GPU family: NVIDIA A100 (or equivalent) instances: +40 guaranteed, +20 burst
- ENIs: +300 per account in us-west-2 to support scale-out of GPU instances
- Subnet IPs: +1024 for warm-pool subnets to avoid IP exhaustion during scale events
- Placement group capacity: enable packing in 2 AZs for low tail-latency (request exception if necessary)
Impact if denied: Increased cold starts, higher 99p latency, customer SLA risk, likely higher transient spend due to on-demand spin-ups
Timeline: Need approval by 3 weeks from now (target deploy 4 weeks)
```

aj: Nice. Add an estimated CPU/ram/GPU node count mapping (how many instances equals 40 GPUs) — support sometimes asks for instance SKU detail.

sasha: Also add the network justification: we use hostNetworking for some setups and create lots of ENIs quickly during scale events. Mention prior incident ID 2025-11-03-azb-ip to show precedent.

maria: Updated: included instance SKUs (p4d.24xlarge / a100-sku-equivalents) and the incident ref. I'm going to open the support case now and tag cloud-ops.

capacity-bot: [automated] Support case opened: CASE-2026-4512 — "Proactive capacity commitment — us-west-2 (warm pool)". ETA vendor response: 48-96h.

cloud-ops: Thanks — I'll also open an internal ticket to pre-allocate extra warm subnet CIDR in our infra-account so we don't wait on cloud provider allocation. Can someone add the exact subnet IDs we want expanded?

maria: Subnets: subnet-0a1b2c3d (us-west-2a-warm), subnet-4d3c2b1a (us-west-2b-warm). Requested +512 each in the internal ticket to leave room for scale and cross-AZ balancing.

leo: We should lock the autoscaler policy to prefer reserved pool nodes first, then spill to spot — include that in rollout notes. Also propose a 12% headroom buffer (i.e., request 45 effective GPUs so we have cushion during AZ skew).

sasha: I think 12% is fine. Also ask support to waive any quota enforcement during our initial 72h ramp so we can burst to the requested levels without manual gates.

maria: Good. I'll update the case with headroom and the temporary enforcement waiver. Draft case comment now: "We request a temporary enforcement waiver during the initial 72h ramp, after which normal quota and billing applies."

aj: One more ops detail — request increased ENI rate (ENIs/sec) for the account, and confirm we have enough per-AZ vpcip addresses. Ask cloud provider for guidance if placement group + large subnets collide with AZ capacity.

maria: Done. CASE-2026-4512 updated with headroom + enforcement waiver ask + instance SKU mapping. Copy of case URL: https://cloud.example.com/support/cases/CASE-2026-4512 (internal link).

cloud-ops: I'll follow up with the provider rep if we don't see a reply in 48h. Also prepping a fallback playbook: auto-shift traffic to us-east-1 read-only replicas + scale dedicated burst there if us-west-2 fails to approve.

leo: For tracking, created a short checklist: 1) support case opened, 2) internal subnet CIDR request, 3) autoscaler policy change, 4) rollout canary plan, 5) billing impact review. I can own 3 and 4 if folks approve.

sasha: Approve. I'll take 2. maria can lead 1 and coordinate with cloud-ops.

maria: Thanks. I'll post updates here as case progresses. If vendor pushback says "no placement exception", we will request AZ spread + increase headroom and re-evaluate.

capacity-bot: [automated] CASE-2026-4512 status update: "Under Review by Provider" — last updated 2026-03-12 16:02 UTC.

maria: Noted. Team — please add any missing justification now; aiming to close this in the next 72h so infra can reserve the warm pool before the feature branch freeze. :thumbsup:
